text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer! Thank you for the day off!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I worked hard yesterday, you know! I did a big cleanup of the whole dorm with Hishiama and the other Miho residents!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I really got down to it and finished everything in a jiffy!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: And then everyone praised me for how good I was at cleaning and tidying. You should've seen their smiling faces!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: It's so refreshing to have a clean room! I sure can get a lot done if I put my mind to it! Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It sounds like Sakura Chiyono O had a very productive day off.
